notes.title: 🕯️Usability Update
notes.content:
New accessibility feature: Skip Game Level
Ideal for use when stuck on a level, you can find it in two places:
[list]
[*] Home/Help & Options/Accessibility
[*] If you fail more than 10 times in a level, the Accessibility button will show up when you pause the game.
[/list]

Optimized keyboard and mouse controls:
[list]
[*] (Optional) Left mouse button to burn
[*] (Optional) Arrow keys to move the character
[/list]

Support wider screen resolutions.

notes.title: Spanish localization update
notes.content:
